product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)

honesty.practice: Tasks are practice. A task list certifies nothing, qualifies nobody and enters no completion record; only the completion contract in completion/ decides what a record says, and it is unchanged by this pack.
honesty.not_certification: Every seat, drill and walk named here keeps its own registry's standing: schematic, unverified general practice, not equipment certification and not an inspection record.
honesty.requires: Linked lessons are the lessons an existing registry already ties to a task. They are a sensible order, never a lock: nothing is gated behind them.
honesty.launch: A launch link is written only when the target page is seen reading that parameter; "lands" says honestly where it puts you (a seat, a hall, a campus, a wilds site or a page section), and a task no link reaches says why.

tasks.title: Tower Crane Lift: Bay high-steel lift
tasks.brief: Tower steel over the bay on a still morning - a clean yard, nothing between you and your own swing.

tasks.title: Tower Crane Lift: Oakland terminal lift
tasks.brief: Container stacks crowd the swing path - carry high and slow, the corridors are tight.

tasks.title: Tower Crane Lift: Crescent wharf lift

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Tower Crane Lift seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: A steady river breeze leans on the load the whole carry - trim your swing against it.

tasks.title: Tower Crane Lift: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Hoist rope and hook; Slew ring and bolts; Counterweight; Limit switches; Base and ballast

tasks.title: Excavator Trench Cut: Seismic retrofit cut

launch.why: no hall on the treasure-island campus teaches the Excavator Trench Cut seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Deep footing cells beside a braced frame - long careful digs, one flagged conduit crossing.

tasks.title: Excavator Trench Cut: Old-fill utility cut
tasks.brief: Waterfront fill ground, crowded with legacy lines - two flagged cells stop shallow.

tasks.title: Excavator Trench Cut: Below-sea trench

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Excavator Trench Cut seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: High water table, one live utility at half depth - the flagged cell stops shallow.

tasks.title: Excavator Trench Cut: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Tracks and rollers; Bucket teeth and pins; Boom hydraulics; Slew brake; The trench edge

tasks.title: Forklift Yard Run: Island yard run

launch.why: no hall on the treasure-island campus teaches the Forklift Yard Run seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: The training yard lane - four gates and a full-width dock bay to land the pallet in.

tasks.title: Forklift Yard Run: Terminal container lane
tasks.brief: A fifth gate threads the container rows - longer lane, same clean-run law.

tasks.title: Forklift Yard Run: Wharf dock set

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Forklift Yard Run seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: The wharf dock is narrow - four gates, then a set-down with little room to be wrong.

tasks.title: Forklift Yard Run: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Tires and wheel nuts; Fork heels and locks; Mast chains; Horn and beeper; Seatbelt and overhead guard

tasks.title: Weld Bead Run: Deck plate seam
tasks.brief: A flat deck seam on the fabrication floor - the forgiving band to learn the rhythm in.

tasks.title: Weld Bead Run: Pipe flange bead
tasks.brief: A longer run at a tighter gap - the plant inspector reads every millimetre of it.

tasks.title: Weld Bead Run: Tank shell seam

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Weld Bead Run seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Storage-tank shell plate in Gulf humidity - a slightly higher band, the same clean-bead law.

tasks.title: Weld Bead Run: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Leads and clamps; Gas and regulator; Welding screens; Fume extraction; Fire watch kit

tasks.title: Scaffold Bay Build: Yard training bay
tasks.brief: One lift in the training yard - three planks, two rails, the order to learn by heart.

tasks.title: Scaffold Bay Build: Plant maintenance bay
tasks.brief: A wider bay against the plant wall - four planks to deck before anyone stands the lift.

tasks.title: Scaffold Bay Build: Storm-hardening bay

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Scaffold Bay Build seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Hurricane-season work - a third rail goes on, and the same legal order holds in the wind.

tasks.title: Scaffold Bay Build: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Sills and bearing; Frames plumb and level; Brace pins; Plank condition; The scaffold tag

tasks.title: Rigging Signal Call: First lift card
tasks.brief: The training card: five calls, one direction change, the stop to finish - learn the hands.

tasks.title: Rigging Signal Call: Blind terminal pick
tasks.brief: The operator cannot see this load - six calls thread it out of the container shadow.

tasks.title: Rigging Signal Call: River-wind card

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Rigging Signal Call seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: The river breeze wants the load moving - six calls with two swings hold the line to the set.

tasks.title: Rigging Signal Call: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Line of sight; Radio and whistle; Slings and shackles; The load path; Exclusion zone

tasks.title: Load Chart Judgment: Yard pick list
tasks.brief: Five picks off the training pad - one of them is over the chart, and the chart wins.

tasks.title: Load Chart Judgment: Terminal heavy list
tasks.brief: Six terminal picks, two of them over - the foreman will push, the chart will not.

tasks.title: Load Chart Judgment: Barge transfer list

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Load Chart Judgment seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Five barge picks with two over the chart - the river will not forgive the one you talk into.

tasks.title: Load Chart Judgment: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: The chart itself; Radius markers; Ground bearing; Wind check; Hook block

tasks.title: Pressure Washer Surface Clean: Ferry terminal seawall
tasks.brief: Graffiti on the ferry terminal seawall panel - a forgiving concrete face to learn the sweep on.

tasks.title: Pressure Washer Surface Clean: Terminal bulkhead fouling
tasks.brief: Rust bloom on a steel bulkhead panel at the marine terminal - a wider panel, the same clean-cell law.

tasks.title: Pressure Washer Surface Clean: Levee floodwall mildew
tasks.brief: Gulf humidity grows mildew fast on the floodwall panel - a taller face, containment matters more here.

tasks.title: Pressure Washer Surface Clean: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Eye and face protection; GFCI-protected power source; Wand trigger lock; Hose condition; Work-area containment

tasks.title: Airless Paint Sprayer Finish: Ferry terminal finish coat
tasks.brief: A fresh finish coat on the terminal exterior wall - the forgiving panel to learn the pass rhythm on.

tasks.title: Airless Paint Sprayer Finish: Dockside warehouse finish
tasks.brief: A wider warehouse wall panel at the terminal - more travel, the same even-coat law.

tasks.title: Airless Paint Sprayer Finish: Shotgun house finish coat

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Airless Paint Sprayer Finish seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: A taller shotgun-house exterior wall panel - humidity punishes a slow pass, hold the rhythm.

tasks.title: Airless Paint Sprayer Finish: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Respirator and ventilation; Spray-tip guard; Pressure-relief procedure; Drop-cloth and masking; Fire and ignition sources

tasks.title: Boom Lift Basket Work: Curtain-wall panel run
tasks.brief: Six anchor points up a curtain-wall bay on the island campus, with the site power drop strung across in front of them - the run to learn the basket on, and the first thing to learn is that it is not clear overhead.

tasks.title: Boom Lift Basket Work: Terminal light-fixture run

launch.why: no hall on the oakland campus teaches the Boom Lift Basket Work seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Four fixture points along a terminal canopy with a live feeder running overhead between the pad and the work - go up before you go out.

tasks.title: Boom Lift Basket Work: Storm-shutter run

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Boom Lift Basket Work seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: Five shutter anchors low on a warehouse wall before the season turns, with a service drop overhead - short reaches, the same tie-off law.

tasks.title: Boom Lift Basket Work: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Tires, outriggers and the pad; Controls and emergency lowering; Guardrails and gate; Harness and anchor point; Overhead-hazard scan

tasks.title: Overhead Crane Shop Move: Fabrication-shop coil move
tasks.brief: A steel coil from the receiving pad to the slitter stand across the island fab shop - one bench to clear, the aisle to stay off.

tasks.title: Overhead Crane Shop Move: Foundry ladle-frame move
tasks.brief: A ladle frame from the pour line to the maintenance bay at the Oakland foundry - two mould stacks under the route, carry high.

tasks.title: Overhead Crane Shop Move: Boat-shed engine move

launch.why: no hall on the new-orleans campus teaches the Overhead Crane Shop Move seat, and the 3D page picks a scenario only by the campus of the hall it opens

tasks.brief: A marine engine from the crate to the test stand in a Gulf boat shed - a narrow bay, a tight square, the crew aisle right through the middle.

tasks.title: Overhead Crane Shop Move: walkaround
tasks.brief: 5 points: Hook latch and block; Wire rope and sheaves; Upper-limit switch test; Pendant and e-stop; Runway and aisle

tasks.title: Survey control on the high ground
tasks.brief: High Country: A control point and a drone landing square; everything below is laid out from here.

tasks.title: Utility line clearance
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A distribution line through the timber: the right-of-way cut back and the line walked for faults.

tasks.title: Trail bridge crew
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A timber footbridge over a creek; carpenters framing, labourers packing material in.

tasks.title: Wildfire fuel break
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A strip thinned and cleared along a ridge; machines and hand crews working the same ground.

tasks.title: Timber-frame shelter raising
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A post-and-beam shelter raised in a clearing; bents lifted and pinned.

tasks.title: Lake intake and main
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A raw-water intake at the lake edge feeding a main down the valley.

tasks.title: Fire lookout tower
tasks.brief: Deep Timber: A steel lookout on the highest knoll; the frame erected and the access scaffold tagged.

tasks.title: Run-of-river intake and penstock
tasks.brief: Red Rock Canyon: A low weir and an intake feeding a penstock down to a small powerhouse; divers work the screens.

tasks.title: Pipeline river crossing
tasks.brief: Red Rock Canyon: A pipeline crossing the canyon; tie-in digs on each side and a permit closed the way it opened.

tasks.title: Valve vault rescue drill
tasks.brief: Red Rock Canyon: A buried valve vault on the mesa used for a confined-space entry and retrieval drill.

tasks.title: Mesa-top solar array
tasks.brief: Red Rock Canyon: Racking and strings laid out across a flat mesa top.

tasks.title: Quarry bench and blast pattern
tasks.brief: Red Rock Canyon: A stepped quarry face with a drill pattern marked out; everybody knows where not to stand.

tasks.title: Levee pump station
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: A drainage pump station set into the levee; wastewater crews keep the pumps, screens and wet well working.

tasks.title: River terminal berth
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: A barge berth with a crane working cargo; the lane is briefed before anything swings.

tasks.title: Timber pile trestle over a bayou
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: A pile-supported trestle across a channel: new piles driven from a rig on firm footing, old bents inspected.

tasks.title: Outfall line and dive station
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: An outfall pipe running into the channel; a dive team inspects it from a station on the bank.

tasks.title: Spill boom staging
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: Containment boom and a skimmer staged on the bank, ready to deploy across a channel mouth.

tasks.title: Wind turbine staging yard
tasks.brief: Salt Marsh Delta: A turbine erected on the ridge beside a laydown yard where blades and tower sections wait for the crane.
